entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnedLitanyDescription
entry.value: Increases the damage of this unit and nearby allied Chaos Space Marines infantry units and reduces their morale loss.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnedLitanyFlavor
entry.value: The hymns of the Ecclesiarchy are still sung, but every verse now ends in a name that was once forbidden.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/WrathfulCommunionDescription
entry.value: Each enemy killed by this unit restores its morale, grants it bonus damage for 2 turns, restores the morale of nearby allied Chaos Space Marines units and reduces the cooldown of Damned Litany and Warp Stride.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/WrathfulCommunionFlavor
entry.value: Every death she deals is a prayer answered. The Dark Gods reward the faithful, and the faithful around her feel it.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BloodAbsolutionDescription
entry.value: Restores the morale of the target allied unit and greatly reduces its morale loss for 1 turn.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BloodAbsolutionFlavor
entry.value: “Confess nothing. Kneel to no one. Your sins are already paid in blood, and the Gods have accepted the payment.”

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/WarpStrideDescription
entry.value: Teleports to the target explored tile. Costs influence.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/WarpStrideFlavor
entry.value: She does not march to the battlefield. She steps out of the Warp where the fear is strongest and the prey is closest.
